visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a scenic long shot of a rocky coastline under a bright blue sky with wispy clouds. Green grass and low-lying vegetation occupy the foreground, leading to a beach of dark, smooth stones and the calm ocean. Yellow text overlays appear at the top. (2) A woman with vibrant pink hair, wearing sunglasses and a white hooded jacket, stands in front of a white ferry boat. She looks into the camera and speaks. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of the ferry. The woman is seated in a red and black chair, gesturing with two fingers. Other passengers are visible in the background of the cabin. (4) A row of black scooters is parked neatly in front of a building with colorful purple and pink walls. (5) A panning shot shows a busy harbor with blue fishing boats and a larger white ferry docked against a backdrop of green hills and a bright sky. (6) A door opens to reveal a tidy hotel room with a white bed, a wooden desk, and a television. The lighting is bright and indoor. (7) The woman is seen in a close-up, wearing a hat and glasses, enthusiastically eating a large piece of fried chicken. (8) Successive fast-cut shots show her drinking through a straw from a white cup and eating a burger, with her face close to the camera. (9) A wide shot displays a lush green mountain overlooking a harbor area with buildings. (10) The woman walks down a brightly lit hallway, looking towards the camera and smiling slightly as the video concludes.
